{{Quote|I don't answer to Imperial puppets.|Jalta|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Jalta''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] who served as a member of the [[Corellian Council]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He was [[Death/Legends|executed]] by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] for refusing to serve the Empire.

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I can take your worst Sith tricks! Just know that Corellians will always fight for their planet!|Jalta refusing to serve the Sith|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />}}
As a fellow council member, Jalta was brave and saw how evil the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were, and would never allow him and other Corellians to serve them.

==Behind the scenes==
Jalta is a character in the 2011 ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' video game, appearing in the Corellia Empire story.

If [[Darbin Sull]] is spared, when he encourages his fellow councilors to bow to their new rulers, Jalta will defiantly refuse, calling Sull an Imperial puppet. The player(s) can either execute or spare Jalta.

If Sull is executed, Jalta will brazenly attack the player character(s) but is disabled. As above, he can be spared or executed.
